title: No Paradise If You Are Killed by a Woman
overview: A female Kurdish-Norwegian sniper returns to the battlefield she once escaped, driven by vengeance and by the desperate hope of rescuing her younger sister, still imprisoned by ISIS in Mosul.

title: The Perfect Holiday
overview: The group of friends from “Das perfekte Geheimnis” have to ask themselves the question on a chaotic short trip to the south: Is there life after the truth or is their friendship over?
Set in a medical college in a dread-stricken village, the film confronts the science behind superstitions, the superstitions in science, and an anomaly that neither can explain.

title: Will You Be My Son?
overview: Lucía, a 42-year-old woman, discovers her partner's infidelity after a 15-year relationship and must reorganize her personal and professional life. She asks her young neighbor to pretend to be her son for a job opportunity.

title: Fallen Angels by Noël Coward
overview: Two upper-class wives, their husbands away for the day, share a few toasts to their pre-marital dalliances—with the same man, who just may be en route from France to visit. Old rivalries and past scandals bubble to the surface in this intoxicating romp from one of theatre’s comedy masters.

title: Blöde Kuh
overview: In a remote mountain setting, Nina tries to balance the fine line between her daughter Jana’s need for affection and her prepubescent attempts for independence, giving her the freedom she desires without losing their connection to each other. But without the comforts of their usual life, tensions between mother and daughter arise as they struggle between the need for closeness and the desire for independence.

title: Свинцовые небеса
overview: The plot tells of several civilians captured by the Ukrainian side and locked in an Orthodox church. The Ukrainian Armed Forces plan to use this point as a trap to close the cauldron for the Russian army, and to use the civilians as a human shield. Having learned about this, the heroes develop their own plan, ready to die, but not to allow the implementation of the plans of the Ukrainian nationalists.

title: Hop-Nation
overview: In a near-future dystopia set inside 22nd-century's Portugal, a Leader and a Court Jester face off with the future of the new regime at stake. Inspired by Edgar Allan Poe's short-story.

title: The Night Everything Changed
overview: When Tina's teenage daughter doesn't return home from a sleepover with her closest friends, she goes on a frantic hunt to find her before it's too late. In the process, she unravels dark secrets of a forbidden romance and a tryst among BFFs.

title: Sippiyan Sitaare
overview: Determined to become a top fashion designer, small-town dreamer Jagga moves to the bustling city and joins quiet tailor Samar. When sudden hardships threaten their venture, the duo must unite to rebuild their shared dream.

title: Detective Conan: The Counterfeit Case of Ultra 30
overview: As a new 10,000-yen banknote featuring the Touto Tower design is issued and the nation is swept up in excitement, Conan and the Junior Detective League, accompanied by Professor Agasa, Ran, and Sonoko, visit the Nagano factory of the Japan Banknote Printing Bureau. Meanwhile, counterfeit money is discovered at the scene of a murder in Tokyo, prompting the Metropolitan Police Department to establish an investigation headquarters. As the unprecedented circulation of counterfeit new banknotes throws the public into confusion, Conan and Heiji head to Osaka, where the counterfeit money is believed to have been printed.

title: Surviving Hurricane Otis
overview: Two estranged brothers struggle to survive Hurricane Otis in Acapulco, where their bond and courage turn adversity into hope.

title: Gajab Raat
overview: A corrupt, troubled cop's night spirals out of control when a reluctant act of mercy toward an injured girl pulls him into a deadly web of crime.

title: A Talent for Murder
overview: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

title: Udta Teer
overview: An amnesiac Pakistani spy wakes up believing he is a patriotic Indian counter-terrorism officer.

title: Pehla Pyaar Doosri Baar
overview: Three friends attend their school reunion and enter into different relationships, discovering the trials, tribulations, allure, and absurdities of love.

title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
overview: It's a matter of life and death for Alison, Mike, Mia and the Ghosts.

title: Love Language
overview: After a failed engagement, a woman discovers a talent for writing wedding vows, but her growing success and new romance are complicated when she’s hired to write vows for her former college flame’s wedding.

title: Rowing
overview: Nele’s whole life is centered around rowing. Together with her best friend Dina, she trains every single day without exception. But Dina is struggling with her own body – her skin is turning scaly and spikes start growing out of her back. While Nele tries to keep her focused on training, Dina decides to listen to her body and surrender to the transformation. Not only is their shared passion at risk of falling apart, so too is their friendship in jeopardy.

title: Lapland War
overview: Young soldier Heikki fights on the Karelian Isthmus alongside his friend Pauli. Arvo, recently released from prison, joins the company, challenging the others' views on war and duty with his worldview. The ceasefire raises hopes of returning home, but it soon becomes clear that Finland must turn against its former German allies in Lapland. At the same time, Saara, who works as a German interpreter in Rovaniemi, must choose her future: stay in Finland or flee to Germany with her beloved, Major Duisberg.

title: Winter Wonderlanes
overview: Audrey Bell  is a globe-trotting pop-up restaurateur who returns home for Thanksgiving to the news that her late grandfather’s beloved bowling alley, Wonderlanes, will be sold. Audrey agrees to stay for one last festive season at Wonderlanes and decides to revive its iconic Winter Wonderlanes youth bowling tournament. To drum up publicity for the event, she reluctantly teams up with Jason Miller, a local news reporter and her high school boyfriend. Working side by side the embers of their past start flickering, rekindling feelings they thought they left behind. As the tournament draws near, Audrey questions her next move that will take her away from the people and places she loves…and decide if she’s ready to walk away from Wonderlanes – or finally put down roots where her heart truly belongs.

title: Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi
overview: Sequel to Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun.

title: Killer Card
overview: A former addict fighting for a new life is pulled back into darkness when a shadowy manipulator targets her deepest fears. As a mysterious card triggers a chain of psychological horrors, Elisa must confront her past before it destroys everything she's built.

title: The Diary of a Chambermaid
overview: A young Romanian woman living in France works for a French family and joins a theatre company who are adapting Octave Mirbeau's The Diary of a Chambermaid.

title: Holidays
overview: Eleven-year-old Fridolin lives far away, with his mother. That’s why he only sees his father, Jan, during the holidays – which Frido looks forward to like crazy. His adventurous dad always comes up with loads to do – after all, he’s the best dad in the world! But unfortunately, Jan has a serious drinking problem...

title: Tu Hai Meri Kiran
overview: What starts as a real connection for her turns into his all-consuming obsession. As love darkens, the boundary between devotion and danger fades.

title: Bad Lieutenant: Tokyo
overview: A corrupt gambler in the Metropolitan Police Force finds himself thrown into a tangled case after an enigmatic FBI agent arrives in Tokyo to investigate the disappearance of a politician’s daughter.

title: The 3 Killer Pigs
overview: A local farmer is desperate and does the unthinkable in his attempt to get his precious livestock back. A blood oath is put in place when the killer pigs make their way back to where their nightmare began. Darkness shrouds the farmhouse and its occupants when the three piggies come home.

title: White Lightning
overview: WHITE LIGHTNING is a gritty, funny, and uniquely American story about second chances, legacy, and what it takes to outrun your past. This feature-length documentary follows 18-year-old sprinter King Combest as he attempts to break his father’s 25-year-old national high school record–and the cycle of drugs, jail, and poverty that has shaped his Kentucky family for generations. King’s father Casey (aka “White Lightning”) was once an elite sprinter destined for Olympic greatness before a marijuana arrest derailed his career and left him working as a janitor on the margins of society. As King chases his father’s iconic record, it becomes clear that the real stakes are far greater: becoming the first man in the Combest family to earn a college degree and forging a path beyond a legacy of crime and addiction.

title: Nhang
overview: A young mother attempts to carry on the Vietnamese tradition of đám giỗ with her young son. As she lights the incense, the ritual transports her back to memories of childhood and the grandmother who taught her how to carry tradition forward. But the memories reveal something she had forgotten. Now, she must decipher what it means to honor the past while making room for something of her own.

title: Drama Kings
overview: It is about two struggling actors, Krille and Martin, who discover that a famous producer has stolen their film idea about a kidnapping. They decide to stage a kidnapping of their own, but things get out of hand.

title: The Castle
overview: "The Castle" follows three siblings left to fend for themselves after their mother suddenly disappears. Connor, Jamie, and Mia try to keep their lives afloat, transforming their suburban house into a makeshift fortress as they wait for her return. Told through the eyes of wildly imaginative middle brother Connor, "The Castle" traces fraying sibling relationships, survival strategies, and the grand stories children tell each other to feel safe. A tender, soulful story about growing up too soon, and rescuing yourself before it’s too late.

title: Ilona
overview: The trial of Ilona Tóth and her co-defendants, a case of post-’56 reprisals, received widespread publicity and remains a subject of controversy to this day. According to the charges, the young medical student abused her professional position to execute an innocent man with particular cruelty. Despite the confessions, the absurdity of the trial’s details and the numerous contradictions suggest that the young people sentenced to death were victims of a show trial. In this true-crime film, using modern investigative methods, we explore the methods of reprisal, the cruelty of show trials, and why those in power needed this show trial, as well as how they sought to discredit the revolution in the eyes of international public opinion through it.

title: Yaga
overview: In this psychological descent into ancient witchcraft, power, and seduction, two investigators unlock dark secrets after questioning a mysterious professor about a missing student.

title: Rise and Shine
overview: Terri Steele has waited her whole life for high school. She wants what every teenager wants: new friends, a beautiful dress, a date to prom and the chance to be seen for exactly who she is. Her mother, Janice, has spent Terri’s whole life helping her believe the world can make room for her. Now they must discover what it means to let go, grow up and step into a new day.

title: Do You Understand Or Do I Have To Spell It Out For You?
overview: Madrid, Spring 1992. Pepe, owner of a Catalan tavern in Chueca, faces the worst streak of his life: his bar is in ruin, his wife leaves him and the debts drown him. When he thinks all is lost, his friends propose a twist as unexpected as brilliant: turn the tavern into a gay pub! What happens from there is an unstoppable succession of entanglements, crazy situations and endearing characters, in a politically incorrect comedy, current, and absolutely smarty.

title: Memento Mori
overview: Memento Mori is a techno-horror short film about Silas, a man in his thirties who works as a content moderator. His job pushes him to the brink as he repeatedly wades through extremely violent and sexually explicit videos and imagery. These repeated viewings cause him to obsess over his mortal and corporeal self, spiraling him into mind-bending departures from reality. His existential concerns are compounded only further as he grieves the death of his father and a past that continues to haunt him.

title: Forgotten Holiday
overview: Kathryn Liu is an antiques buyer for her father’s store and has been happily dating Rob Ashford for nearly a year. When he surprises her with a pre-Christmas proposal, her fear of a failed relationship sends her dashing away without giving him an answer. Heartbroken, as Rob drives to his sister’s house he has a car accident that leaves him without memories of the past year, including their relationship and his once-infectious love of Christmas. Following the unconventional orders from his doctor, Kathryn agrees to help trigger Rob’s memory by retracing their romance and reintroducing him to the holidays. But as his memories inch closer to returning, Kathryn must face the painful truth that bringing Rob back to himself may mean losing him forever, unless she can finally find the courage to fight for the love she was too afraid to claim.

title: 200 Lives, Paco Rabal
overview: Through cassette recordings of his voice and the super8 films of his travels, film shoots and festivals he would attend despite his political engagement as a screen idol of the Franco era, Paco Rabal (Best Actor Award at the first Festival in 1953 and Donostia Award in 2001) looks back at his life, regrets and contradictions. An impressive list of films recalling the time of his death in Bordeaux, like Goya, the man he played several times. In San Sebastián, he enjoyed success alongside Rafael Gil, Lucas Demare, León Klimovsky, Pedro Olea and Jaime de Armiñán.

title: A Night in Paradiso
overview: A one-of-a-kind immersive live theatre experience put to film. A 1970s variety talent show hosted by washed up actor, Dana Valentine, who finds himself haunted by a mysterious figure reminiscent of his old co-star, Finley Zopilote, taking the form of the role that was stolen from him.

title: AAA Héroes Inmortales 2026 - Week 1
overview: Héroes Inmortales 2026 is a professional wrestling event produced by Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide. It takes place on October 24, 2026, at Gimnasio Olímpico Juan de la Barrera in Mexico City, Mexico.

title: Gush
overview: Elliot drags bestie Skylar along to her ex-girlfriend's Sálon. Seeking refuge from the boob-shaped discussion bowl in the bathroom; they get stuck in a tampon mishap stickier than the bad blood between old flames.

title: My Funeral
overview: Have you ever wondered what the day of your funeral will be like?  Juanca is a ghost who visits his own funeral. He listens to conversations from the people he knows and discovers good things, bad things, and things he’d rather not know—even in death. From the afterlife, Juanca will try to do everything he can to clean up his legacy.

title: The Infinite
overview: Charlie Donovan, on the brink of losing everything he loves, is drawn into a fateful journey with seven strange strangers, each of whom holds a key to save him from self-destruction.

title: What If Christmas
overview: Erin has always supported her husband Adam, a heart surgeon, by organizing the hospitals' Christmas charity galas. However, when he moves to a new hospital, her help is no longer needed. Feeling lost and without a purpose back in New York City, her long-suppressed regrets over giving up her dream of pursuing fashion design start bubbling up. When Erin is given a peculiar heart-shaped Christmas ornament, she wakes up in an alternate reality where she's a world-famous fashion designer. As she "meets" and attends Christmas events with alternate-universe Adam, she realizes that while her fashion dreams came true, it's lonely at the top. While working on a way to bring more charity and heart to her fashion empire, she learns that her dream life and love were always right in front of her – if only she finds the heart and courage to ask.

title: BTS: THE RETURN
overview: They're back! BTS gathers in LA to record their album "Arirang" in this documentary offering unprecedented access to the band as they enter a new era.

title: Forza
overview: An impoverished thirteen-year-old adolescent from the slums of Bali finds his aspirations of professional football within reach after forming an unlikely partnership with a veteran athlete on the verge of retirement, culminating in an unprecedented trial with the AC Milan Youth Academy in Italy.

title: Bread of Hope
overview: The life of Nazan, who runs the small town bakery "Tatlı Maya" (Bread of Hope) all on her own, changes when a young Syrian woman named Rana walks through her door. Already in labor, Rana gives birth to her baby inside the bakery. Having lost her husband, been evicted from her home, and left with nowhere else to go, Rana is taken in by Nazan—first into her own home, and later into the bakery. As a quiet bond forms between the two women amidst the rhythms of daily life, rumors begin to spread and intensify throughout the town. Fueled in part by Sami—a man who has long harbored an interest in Nazan—these prejudices lead customers to abandon the bakery, eventually resulting in the authorities sealing off "Tatlı Maya" on the grounds that Rana was being employed there illegally. Nazan begins to pay a heavy price for the decision she made.

title: CORRUPTIONLAND
overview: CORRUPTIONLAND is a propulsive, 35-minute documentary that reveals for the first time the full extent of the rot in Trump’s Washington — and how it can be reversed.

title: Rent: 30th Anniversary Concert
overview: Original cast members and a bevy of special guests revive the Tony Award- and Pulitzer Prize-winning rock musical sensation Rent in a gala concert celebration for the show’s 30th anniversary. The one-night-only concert of the full show will take place on Monday, October 26, at Broadway’s Richard Rodgers Theatre as a benefit for Broadway Cares/Equity Fights AIDS.

title: Drive - The Pretenders
overview: A young mechanic fakes an engagement with racing's most scandalous star — officially for his reputation, secretly for her own shot behind the wheel. But soon the lie threatens to destroy everything — including what's already become so much more than just a deal.

title: The Teenage Vampire
overview: When a straightlaced young woman moves into a chic bungalow in the Hollywood Hills she imagines nothing but raging parties and romance in her future. But Sandra's new dream house quickly becomes a den of horrors after she discovers her landlords are ancient vampires and her first party guests are the victims of a bloody massacre. As the night grows more sinister and twisted, Sandra unearths the most terrifying secret of all.

title: Second Season
overview: A few years ago, Paula Ferrara wrote “The Pussy and the Razor.” Its success turned her into “the voice of her generation.” Today, Paula is a failed writer—a ghostwriter who earns a living churning out books for mediocre influencers. Her latest, desperate assignment is to pen the biography of Lil Rogelio, a fading trap music legend fresh out of prison who is supposedly seeking redemption. But are Paula and Lil Rogelio truly prepared for this second season?

title: The Lost Ones
overview: When a perfect family relocates to rural America, their isolated idyll quickly becomes threatened by a disturbingly volatile neighbor.

title: Gloryland
overview: Last spring, unknown lights appeared in the sky above Lausanne. In a garden, the last fragment of an ordinary Eden, tales blur with rumours after a series of strange disappearances.

title: Kordell Stewart / Slash & Burn
overview: For a generation of football fans, former Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Kordell "Slash" Stewart was one of the most electrifying players of the 1990s. But just as he became one of football's biggest stars, a malicious rumor upended his life. Through candid interviews with Stewart and others who witnessed his brightest and darkest moments, explore the personal toll of scrutiny beyond the football field while searching for the truth behind a story that followed Stewart for decades.

title: Saravah
overview: A man takes on a ghostwriting job, bringing three former classmates together after ten years to untangle their hilariously complicated lives.

title: Breeder
overview: An eccentric poodle breeder lures a broke college student to her remote ranch with a promise of research funding. But, as he soon learns, there’s a catch.

title: Moulin
overview: In June 1943, Jean Moulin, leader of the French Resistance, is arrested while attempting to reunite the forces of the "Armée Secrète." Interrogated by Klaus Barbie, the head of the Gestapo in Lyon, Moulin is drawn into a relentless confrontation.

title: Elisa
overview: Following a nuclear war, life on Earth has all but come to an end. Solisvita has placed a small group in an ancient cavern—equipped with a 180-day supply of water and provisions—tasking them with locating a rare "ore" essential for producing "Geneterna," a treatment designed to grant humans genetic immunity to radiation. Once the mission is complete, they are to be relocated to protected "Fortress Cities." However, communication with headquarters is severed, their water supply is running dangerously low, and with only eight days left in the mission, Emre—the project lead—takes his own life. Meanwhile, a mysterious stranger arrives at their door, sharing legends that hint at a hidden water source deep within the cavern. As trust begins to unravel, each member of the group is forced to confront the true cost of survival and the real nature of Solisvita—the organization they once believed to be their savior.

title: The Phantom of the Opera
overview: Anastasia, an 18-year-old ballet dancer at the Opéra Garnier, becomes the obsession of a disfigured man living in the opera's underground labyrinth.

title: Lucy Lost
overview: Set in 1915 in the Isles of Scilly just off the Cornish coast, a young girl named Lucy is raised by a clan of fishermen she knows not to be hers. However, she remembers little else about her past, and as the Great War rages down on the continent, a chance encounter with the mysterious girl her own age soon helps Lucy put back the pieces of her own life’s story and come to better understand her place in the world.

title: Death of Truth
overview: The orderly, solitary life of Feridun is shaken by the arrival of his old friend Timuçin, who carries the burden of murders they committed in the past. As Timuçin contemplates turning himself in, Feridun must stop him to protect his own freedom.

title: My Duchess
overview: Telling the story of the final years of the woman who married King Edward VIII and broke up the monarchy.

title: Words of Love
overview: For 14 years, Erika has been the anchor of a household that rarely stands still, doing her best to raise teenage Abigail, her whirlwind little brother, Yoni, and a dog with an extreme devotion to cheese. When Abi’s desire to meet her absent father grows into a full-blown obsession and word spreads he’s been seen nearby, Erika fears the fragile balance will collapse for good. Instead, the unpredictable journey that follows brings mother and daughter to see each other anew, steering their lively, lovable family toward a happy new chapter.

title: Red Crown
overview: Twenty-five contestants compete for a P25 million cash prize at the 25th-anniversary "Queen of the Islands" pageant.

title: Ancient Blue
overview: Kenan Yelkıran, a solitary fisherman whose boat was seized due to his debts, goes missing in the heart of a deadly storm. When he washes ashore two months later—his mind a vast, empty void—the town receives him with a dark and unsettling suspicion. As Kenan struggles to piece together his shattered sense of reality, the cursed spirits of ancient times and the ceaseless whispers of the sea begin to haunt his mind. The time has finally come: Kenan must confront the terrifying secret buried deep within his own consciousness and put an end to this age-old cycle of sin.

title: Ugly Duckling Ms. Maeng
overview: Ms. Maeng, a small-town teacher, unexpectedly joins the team responsible for creating South Korea’s most important exam: the College Scholastic Ability Test. She thought it would be all about academic prestige and scholarly debate but instead finds herself locked away under spy-level security, her phone confiscated and surrounded by office politics. Can this unlikely underdog turn test stress into test success, or just test everyone's patience?

title: Back to the Beginning: Ozzy's Final Bow
overview: A powerful return to roots, this concert captures Black Sabbath in peak form - reuniting to deliver classic hits with raw energy and legendary precision.

title: Hating
overview: Ondřej Šálek’s time-lapse documentary captures an escalating street battle between pro-Russian activists at a petition stall in Prague’s Klárov district and a group of liberal-minded citizens who have decided to take justice into their own hands. Footage from live streams and first-hand observations reveal verbal and physical altercations and the growing radicalisation of both camps. This unsettling account of the forms taken by civil resistance in a sharply polarised society does not adopt the perspective of either side. An impartial observation of the actions and counter-actions shows how easily a sense of threat and the desire to belong to a particular community can escalate into aggression.

title: The Awakening
overview: An elite military unit on a mission in the South American jungle encounters a deadly supernatural force revealing an ancient presence that continues to claim anyone who dares enter its domain.

title: The Mongoose
overview: A falsely accused war hero with nothing to lose leads police on an epic televised cross-country car chase, helped by members of his former Special Forces Army battalion and closely monitored by a fascinated public rooting for his safe getaway.

title: You, Me, Us
overview: A couple faces the difficult path to adoption, determined to become parents despite their complex vulnerabilities.

title: Log 15
overview: Driven to save her mother from Alzheimer's, a desperate woman documents her radical experiments to unlock the human mind, only to discover the footage she is recording is actively rewriting her own reality.

title: Christmas at the Kringles
overview: After moving to a quiet suburban neighborhood, the Seversons meet the Kringles, a family that celebrates Christmas year-round. When Mark, the father, discovers the Kringles' sinister yuletide intentions, he teams up with a badass Santa in a high-stakes, action-packed fight to save his family.

title: A Very Arctic Christmas
overview: Single dad Jim and his spirited, science-minded 20-year-old daughter, Isla, share a tradition of alternating who decides how they spend Christmas each year. Jim, a former major league baseball player turned broadcaster, never misses hosting his annual Christmas Eve show from Times Square – until Isla persuades him to take a once-in-a-lifetime Arctic cruise, promising they will return in time for his broadcast.

title: Kudrat 1968: High Council
overview: When Abbas returned to KUDRAT, the school was suddenly besieged by authorities following the death of a student, a tragedy the administration had long kept hidden. Tensions between the elite students and the scholarship students reached a breaking point. While Piji was determined to bring down Pa, Abbas and Kuda fought to uphold justice and expose the dark secrets threatening the entire institution.

title: Unsafe
overview: When a young girl becomes trapped inside an airtight safe, firefighter Alex and her partner Jakob are called to a high-pressure rescue with minutes to spare. As oxygen runs out and the girl’s frantic parents demand action, cracks begin to appear in their story. What starts as a desperate life-saving mission quickly unravels into something far more sinister. With time slipping away, Alex and Jakob must uncover the truth behind the child, the couple and the safe itself — before the clock runs out.

title: The Mosquito Bowl
overview: In the aftermath of Pearl Harbor, four college football stars enlist in the US Marines, discovering the strength of brotherhood and the cost of war.

title: Everest: The Other Side
overview: An intimate portrait of two people bound by love, ambition, and the pursuit of the impossible. Elite ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson fell deeply in love while reaching the pinnacle of their sport. Their drive sharpened into a shared dream: to climb and ski the direct North Face of Mount Everest—the most difficult and dangerous climb on the mountain and the most coveted ski line on Earth—something only a handful have ever achieved, and no one has successfully skied down.

title: The Sea Speaks His Name
overview: Set during the volatile final months of Indonesia’s New Order regime, the narrative chronicles a young student activist's perilous commitment to pro-democracy underground movements and his family's subsequent, grueling quest for justice following his forced disappearance.

title: The Blood Countess
overview: The Blood Countess and her maid embark on a quest for the red elixir of life and a book that threatens the vampire realm. Hot on their heels are a police inspector, two vampirologists, a vegetarian nephew and his therapist.

title: The Last Roman God
overview: Through both personal and political conflicts, the film tells the story of emperor Diocletian's rise to power and his complicated place in ancient Rome's court politics.

title: Selma
overview: Neslihan, an unsuccessful actress, and her social media influencer friends break into the home of Selma—a woman suffering from Alzheimer’s—to secretly live-stream her for profit. As their viewership surges, the house begins to reveal its terrifying secrets, and the young women find themselves trapped in a lethal Dark Web show. Now, Neslihan must decide just how far she is willing to go to escape poverty and achieve fame.

title: Jonna: Crónicas de una policía novata
Last Dinner
overview: The film focuses on what it means to truly love someone "in sickness and in health." In the story, talented pianist Canan embarks on a passionate affair with Bekir, a mysterious agent, after saving his life. However, Bekir suddenly disappears. When he returns years later, he finds Canan married someone else. This encounter rekindles a love that had been interrupted years before. Canan is forced to make an impossible choice between her past passion and her present-day loyalty.

title: Dreamboat
overview: When an underground musician’s unconventional romance with her beloved pillow is violently cut short by her mother, she spirals into a delirious odyssey through Mumbai, where her friendships, desires, and grip on reality are tested by an enigmatic homeless poet. As she searches for love and connection in an increasingly alienating city, the abandoned pillow begins to develop a will of its own.

title: Ciudad de muertos
overview: Enrique Metinides, renowned crime photographer, discovers his passion as a child when his camera captures a haunting image of death. This obsession with documenting tragedy shapes his career and transforms his work into art. But as a mysterious figure begins appearing in his photographs, Enrique unravels a chilling secret linking his lens to the shadows of politics and the supernatural.

title: Çatlı 2
overview: Following an attack in Paris, Abdullah Çatlı is imprisoned in France, where he faces mounting danger as his family becomes a target on the outside. Caught amid political tensions and escalating pressure across Europe, he navigates a perilous struggle to protect his loved ones and find a way back home.

title: Shores
overview: Amina’s life revolves around caring for her aging parents and tending to their family home. A surprise visit from her cousin, Azam, brings back memories from 15 years ago. As they catch up on the years lost, they reminisce about her lost love. The unexpected visit gives Amina the closure she never knew she needed, leaving her at peace with her past and more accepting of her present. Years of conflict are resolved through a homecoming and a simple “knock on the door.”

title: Wandering Trees
overview: Piero and his son Giuliano live alone, on the edge of town, in a farmhouse filled with injured animals they collect and care for. The Nonne, local notables, want to drive them out because they live like vagrants. During a snowfall, Piero disappears and the animals are killed. Giuliano has no choice but to search for his father.

title: Free at Heart
overview: Sebastian's (16) sheltered small-town life changes suddenly when his family takes in 15-year-old Kolja, supposedly the son of his father's recently deceased girlfriend. In addition to his little sister, another teenager now lives with them.  Although the two boys are strangers to each other at first, they begin to open up to each other more and more and discover that they are biological brothers. The relationship of trust with his parents breaks down and when Sebastian and Kolja become closer than they expected, Sebastian's life is suddenly turned upside down, as he has found not only a soul mate in his new brother, but also a real, first love. Overwhelmed by their feelings, the two hide their relationship, but when the secret, incestuous relationship is discovered, the family breaks out of the social structure of the small town and comes into conflict with societal norms. Everything that follows is a rollercoaster of emotions.

title: Karaoke Murder
overview: One night, Mrs. Thuy’s ear-splitting karaoke pushes the entire neighborhood to the brink of insanity. But when she is suddenly murdered during a mountain pilgrimage, everyone becomes a suspect. Enter Tam - a young woman with a shady past - who is forced to take matters into her own hands. A rollercoaster of clues and tragicomic situations soon exposes the town's hidden secrets, from blind superstitions and bitter grudges to hilariously conflicting testimonies. As the elusive killer prepares to strike again, Tam must race against time to unmask the culprit before she becomes the next victim.

title: Greatest Performance
overview: During a film shoot where abuse is disguised as artistic direction, a comeback actress commits a devastating performance to survive, exposing how cinema can construct and legitimize violence.  In Ang Lihim ni Teresa (Teresa's Secret), she enters a set where authority is absolute and cruelty is framed as discipline. As production unfolds, she loses control over body, emotion, and authorship, where survival is mistaken for consent.  When violence escalates, she chooses to live, burying the truth as the director’s collapse is rewritten as myth. The set becomes a crime scene without witnesses.  In the aftermath, she is praised for her “courage” while a sound technician retreats into silence. At a commemorative screening, celebration fractures, revealing cinema’s ability to transform violence into narrative and absolution.  The myth of the Kataw appears briefly through Ang Lihim ng Kataw (The Secret of Kataw).

title: Hotel Alcohol
overview: In the psychiatric hospital, the chief doctor organizes the "Olympic Games," in which protagonists Bako, Medea, and Drago form a group called "Hotel Alcohol." They lose the games, leave the hospital, and head toward the sea.

title: Collision Course
overview: Spain, 2013. After robbing a bank, a getaway crash reveals the hidden side of each thief, exposing betrayals and lies that began long before the heist.

title: The Birthday​ Gift​
overview: Single mother Marlene Frischmann organizes a birthday party for her son Theo at her brother's chic country villa, which quickly spirals into family drama, world-view quarrels, and chaos.

title: Wild Horse Nine
overview: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

title: Meethe Mein Kya Hai
overview: A young widower's grief eases at a joyful Diwali reunion — until his sister's surprise marriage throws the family into chaos.

title: La toile
overview: In an isolated house, a father and his son discover a painting that seems disturbingly alive. When their darkest nightmares begin bleeding into reality, a sinister presence emerges from the canvas, feeding on buried trauma and forgotten memories.

title: SCTV: The Greatest Show You've Never Heard Of
overview: Legendary "SCTV" cast members reunite in this documentary for a funny and heartfelt celebration of how a scrappy Canadian sketch show made comedy history.

title: Sight & Sound Presents: JOSHUA—Live!
overview: Journey alongside the people of Israel as they navigate their new-found freedom in an unforgiving wilderness. When Joshua is called to replace Moses as their faithful leader, tensions mount in the midst of dwindling supplies and approaching armies. With one last fortified city standing between the Israelites and the Promised Land, unexpected help emerges from behind enemy lines and Joshua's trust in God's plan is put to the ultimate test.  Filmed in front of a live audience, this special event invites you to experience one of the most redemptive stories of the Bible come to life like never before!

title: Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47 - AK47
overview: A tight-knit family faces an unexpected crisis that threatens their bond, forcing them to re-evaluate their values and fight to stay united.

title: Who's Coming for Christmas?
overview: After relocating to a new town, Julie uses pieces inherited from her late grandmother to create a beautiful Christmas Eve dinner table for eight, trusting that the right guests will find their way to it. As she befriends her neighbor Mark and his young daughter, her holiday plans seem complete, until bad weather keeps them away. With only three seats filled, Julie must rely on a series of small Christmas miracles to bring her dream holiday table to life.

title: Karateka
overview: At 39, Spanish karateka Sandra Sánchez sets her sights on Olympic gold in Tokyo, pushing her career toward its defining test. Her coach and life partner, Jesús del Moral, remains beside her throughout, a bond that turns each step toward the Games into a shared act of commitment.

title: Origin Story
overview: Sofia (Valentina Herszage), a 20-year-old Brazilian actress, arrives at a casting audition for an American film that quickly departs from the familiar.  ORIGIN STORY explores identity, performance, and the enduring influence of the American gaze upon Latin American culture.

title: Philly Pretzels
overview: JUSTIN CROWELL | UNITED STATES | 2026 | 10 MIN | ENGLISH  Barry, a street-side soft pretzel salesman in South Philly, has an unexpected interaction with brash 19-year-old Brianna after a fight with her boyfriend leaves her stranded.  Cast: Adam Shapiro, Abigail Donaghy

title: Scorpion
overview: A teen’s mistake exposes her father as Scorpion, a retired CIA assassin, forcing them on the run from his former mentor and the deadly operatives of The Zoo.

title: Paging Hezbollah
overview: Paging Hezbollah is the extraordinary true story behind an intelligence operation that seemed impossible—how it was conceived, engineered and carried out, as well as the profound geopolitical consequences that followed.

title: Who Killed Alex Odeh?
overview: In October 1985, Santa Ana, California was shaken by a brazen act of political violence when Palestinian American Alex Odeh, a beloved teacher and community leader, was killed by a tripwire bomb planted in his office. Despite substantial evidence and identified suspects, the case was never solved. Who Killed Alex Odeh? reopens the mystery, tracking a renewed investigation in real time as new leads emerge, long-buried records come to light, and the forces behind a political assassination are finally confronted.

title: Ebenezer Scrooge: A Christmas Carol Horror
overview: A horror take on the classic tale. When cruel businessman Ebenezer Scrooge is visited by ghosts on Christmas Eve, he will have to decide whether to heed their warning to change for the better or remain cold-hearted and merciless.

title: Patakka Guddiyan
overview: Roohi, a simple girl, is the complete opposite of her twin sister Mahi, who is sharp, daring, and mischievous. As the story progresses, layers of suspense and drama unfold.

title: The Cull
overview: Wrongly imprisoned for his mother’s murder, Niall is finally released, having found God and renounced a life of violence and addiction. Retreating to a remote woodland cabin seeking redemption and the truth behind her death, he finds a hostile community ruled by a ruthless family, where every encounter deepens the mystery surrounding his mother’s past. As brutal violence erupts and terrifying visions blur the line between nightmare and reality, Niall uncovers a sinister legacy of witchcraft, blood sacrifice and forbidden ritual. Something has been patiently waiting in the forest, and its hunger for vengeance can only be satisfied with blood.

title: Dead Howling
overview: A werewolf hunts zombies after losing his family. He meets two humans seeking sanctuary and joins their quest, protecting them with his powers. Their journey grows perilous as zombies start evolving.

title: Sister Sister 3
overview: Set in traditional Northern Vietnam, where strict social norms prevail, Thi Mau - the region's most beautiful and talented young lady - finds herself caught in a tangled web of secret love and conflicting desires.

title: BTS WORLD TOUR [ARIRANG] in São Paulo
overview: The Latin American leg of BTS WORLD TOUR ‘ARIRANG’ reaches the big screen through a delayed presentation of the São Paulo concert. It brings the scale and excitement of BTS’s stadium performance into the cinema, offering fans a communal live-viewing experience shaped by the energy of a packed Brazilian venue.

title: RYUJI ⻯⼆
overview: The eternal legend etched into Japanese film history, rises again. (remake of the 1983 eponymous film).

title: #Cult
overview: A group of young boys head to a party expecting a night of fun, but soon discover the reality is far darker than they imagined. What starts as excitement spirals into terror, pushing them into a brutal fight for survival.

title: This Solitude
overview: Leo and Lorea have loved one another. Maybe they still do. But something in them has broken. After five years, their relationship is done. He looks after his sick father, trapped between responsibility and an emotional void that weighs him down. She, caught up in poorly-paid jobs and personal crises, tries to get her life back on track without really knowing where to begin. They are two bodies, tired and alone, pierced by their precarious situation, by unresolved issues, by the emotional legacy of a generation who always seem to come late to everything: to love, to stability, to maturity, to serenity, to personal satisfaction.

title: Nakhrewaalii
overview: Sumit Mishra cross-dresses as a woman to win over his love interest, Paridhi.

title: A Story of Derry
overview: Hundreds of years before Pennywise, three youngsters venture into the Western Wood...where they encounter a terrifying ancient spirit.

title: Adopting St. Nick
overview: A single mother finds unexpected romance while helping her daughter connect with a Santa-like resident at a retirement community.

title: Barbie in the Nutcracker
overview: Barbie “Brooklyn” Roberts steps into the role of the Sugarplum Princess and Barbie “Malibu” Roberts stars as Clara, as they journey through a musical, magical dreamworld filled with holiday wonder, courage and friendship.

title: K3 Superhelden
overview: Hanne, Marthe en Julia get a special visit when Superhero Vonk shows up at their door with three superhero suits for them. K3 turns into superheroes, but soon they find out that there is a dark side to it...

title: Poeksie Woeksie
overview: A spin-off of the beloved comedy series, Orkney Snork Nie. Chaos ensues when Ouboet finds himself behind bars, despite being innocent. While Yollie deals with the family crisis, he must prove his innocence to make it home in time for his son’s wedding.

title: The Decay
overview: In a declining medical centre, a desperate patient must convince an embittered GP to diagnose her disturbing symptoms before a deadly plague consumes them both.

title: The SAS
overview: On February 20th, 2016, a college student's friend goes missing. Through phone recordings, we recall the event that led up to his disappearance.

title: AMINETU
overview: In November 2009, Aminetu Haidar returns to El Aaiún after receiving the Civil Courage Prize in New York, only to be expelled without a passport and sent to Lanzarote. There, she begins a 32-day hunger strike, turning the right to return home into a quiet but unyielding confrontation.

title: Frank Stein M.D.
overview: After a freak accident, a brilliant young neurosurgeon must do the unthinkable: Bring his estranged, mad-scientist father back to life.

title: Midnight Snack
overview: Video Nasties Short Film Challenge participant and superfan Bernard Satariano gets the midnight munchies

title: Ungehor§am
overview: The documentary follows activists who are fighting for a more just future through civil disobedience, accepting personal risks and legal consequences in the process. The film tells their David-versus-Goliath stories and places today’s protests for climate protection and human rights within the history of nonviolent resistance.
